versions.content: If the specified channel is configured as an output channel, the Dio_FlipChannel function shall read level of the channel (requirements [SWS_Dio_00083] & [SWS_Dio_00084] are applicable) and invert it, then write the inverted level to the channel. The return value shall be the inverted level of the specified channel.
